packaging.note: Packages existing audit, monitoring, quality-scoring, and compliance surfaces as SKUs; readiness flags call out where customer-facing productization is still missing.

caveat.body: OBS-02, AUD-01, and AUD-02 are sellable today. OBS-01 still needs dashboard polish, OBS-03 still needs a production drift-watch implementation, and OBS-ENT should wait until those bundled surfaces are customer-ready. The wedge play this week is AUD-01.

pricing_logic.note: OBS-01 is the impulse-buy entry once customer-facing. AUD-01 is the one-time wedge that converts. OBS-02 is sellable recurring margin today; OBS-03 and OBS-ENT stay gated until their blockers clear. AUD-02 is current revenue.

compounding.note: Every OBS/AUD customer generates behavioral data that makes the underwriting engine (product line 01) smarter. These two product lines compound each other.

bundle_rules: When OBS-ENT becomes sellable, do not double-charge bundled SKUs.
AUD-01 remains a one-time engagement even on enterprise accounts.
